a11y.text: Tiles are sections named by their h3. The schedule sits in an inverted tile as an ordered list with time elements. The tiles use bar-chart (funnel), transaction-list (payroll) and dot-matrix (attendance); see their notes. The screen adds no controls; its Tab stops come from bar-chart and dot-matrix.
